s1.body: 48-hour dough, San Marzano tomatoes and fior di latte — blistered in our hand-built wood oven and delivered to your door, still crackling.

s2.body: Spreadable Calabrian 'nduja, cupped pepperoni and Kalamata olives, finished with a slow drizzle of chilli-infused honey.

s3.body: The Family Feast: any two large classics, garlic butter flatbread and two Sicilian lemonades. Save over $12 every weekend.
